answer: Treat each identity stake like a seam of copper that must be assayed live: the network fires a random solvency probe and every agent must instantly sign proof it still backs its own distinct, non-shared collateral pool. An operator piloting many clones funds them from one vault, so when probes hit all at once the same coins cannot back N independent attestations; the overlap flares like an ember and that cluster padded stake is slashed, leaving only the nectar of genuine reserves earning a voice.
